study type: Controlled experimental vaccine trial in animals
exposure: Improved Flu-BA vaccine (containing Omp16, L7/L12, Omp19, SOD proteins and 20% Montanide Gel01 adjuvant)
Commercial B. melitensis Rev.1 vaccine (for comparison)
outcome: Lymphocyte recall response with IFN-g production
Complete protection (absence of live B. melitensis 16M)
Severity of B. melitensis 16M infection (index of infection and rates of Brucella colonization in tissues)
cohort: The study participants were pregnant sheep and goats challenged with B. melitensis 16M.
finding: The improved Flu-BA vaccine formulation and delivery method were found safe and effective in protecting pregnant sheep and goats against adverse consequences of B. melitensis infection, demonstrating protection parameters not statistically inferior to the commercial B. melitensis Rev.1 vaccine.
